name: zopt_get_hud_visibility_option
description: zOpt::GetHudVisibilityOption returns the HUD visibility option for the active hardware mode.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this option accessor remains part of the broader zOpt tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x408340 validates testing g_zOpt_HwMode, returning *ZOPT_HUD_HW when non-zero, and returning *ZOPT_HUD_SW otherwise.

The native zOpt accessor smoke verifies the software branch returns the SW HUD visibility value with g_zOpt_HwMode == 0 and the hardware branch returns the HW HUD visibility value with g_zOpt_HwMode != 0.
